1.label: very_easy
1.summary: One contact follows two ribbons with broad bands and slow changing wind.

natural_language_by_interaction.full: Hover over the weave to illuminate local spans and discover the marked source ribbon through its crossings. Inspected spans stay lit; you can inspect safely before energizing. Energize the loom. Drag each ivory servo knob vertically to keep its advancing contact inside the glowing band of the marked source ribbon. Idle time holds after energizing; each completed rail adjustment or newly revealing inspection settles one fixed 0.4-second slice, and a full visible HEAT bar ends the attempt. Keep every contact connected through the entire braid. Faint echoes show the last 0.8 seconds.
